verdict.rationale: Intel's own docs show first-party tooling aimed at Core Ultra Series 2: oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations, VTune Profiler analysis for client GPUs/NPUs, the oneAPI development stack, and OpenVINO NPU support. Copilot+ integration and app-compatibility claims hint at strong OS support. Most of this is AI-inference focused, though, and the pack never shows mature general-purpose compiler support or explicit optimization guides. missing for 10: explicit compiler support/maturity evidence (e.g. a named compiler targeting this architecture), general (non-AI) optimization guidance documentation, explicit OS/toolchain tier-one support statements (Linux/Windows toolchains), independent or hands-on developer corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, this architecture is a first-class development target — mature compilers, official optimization guidance, and an OS and tooling ecosystem that treats it as tier one
